label: The Weibull failure distribution
subgoals: Divide the time by the characteristic life
Raise the ratio to the shape parameter
Compute one minus the exponential of its negative

label: Time to a target failure fraction
section: Time to a target failure fraction
subgoals: Take minus the natural log of one minus the target fraction
Raise it to one over the shape parameter

label: Scaling from test structures to a chip
section: Scaling from test structures to a chip
subgoals: Form the ratio of test area to chip area
Raise it to one over the shape parameter
Multiply the test characteristic life by that factor
